meta_description:
914K likes, 1,528 comments - cbum on September 29, 2026: "My biggest takeaway from this Olympia is realizing what I actually miss.

I miss the emotion that comes with dedicating yourself completely to a goal. Giving everything you have to something, experiencing the highest highs and the lowest lows, and sharing those moments with the people closest to you who saw everything it took to get there.

Watching the athletes on stage and seeing everything they were feeling brought back a lot of memories. There’s something incredibly special about caring that deeply about something and finding out how far you’re willing to go for it.

But at the same time, I felt more clear than ever.

Because I know exactly what it takes to stand on that stage, I also know the sacrifice it requires. And for me, that sacrifice just isn’t worth it anymore.

I can miss parts of that life without wanting it back.

The life I have now, and the life I’m building, mean far more to me than another trophy or another moment in the spotlight.".
